newsitem.title: CHINA: China aims to boost domestic generator industry.
newsitem.headline: China aims to boost domestic generator industry.

text.p: New power plants in China will no longer use foreign-made 300 and 350 megawatt generators, the China Daily Business Weekly on Sunday quoted Power Industry Minister Shi Dazhen as saying.
China should develop its power industry on the basis of domestic products and imports should be supplementary, Shi said.
However, China may have to continue to import 1,000 megawatt generators because does not have the ability to build these yet, he said.
The newspaper said 40 percent of the machine-building industry's capacity for building major generators was idle because of imports.
However, Beijing's decision to withdraw preferential treatment for imported equipment would prevent the import of too many large foreign generators, the newspaper said.

Of China's 235,000 megawatt generating capacity, 80 percent comes from domestically produced equipment. Of 300 megawatt or larger generators, some 50 percent are domestic products, the newspaper said.
